paragraphs: We are proud to be endorsing Barry Moore for the US Senate Seat in Alabama. Barry Moore has a FANTASTIC A+ on our scorecard and is one of two members of the House Freedom Caucus in Alabama.

When Senator Tuberville announced his run for governor rather than reelection, we immediately voiced our support for Barry Moore to run for the Senate Seat and today he announced for it. No one fights for America First in Alabama, more than Congressman Moore.
Barry Moore has our complete and total endorsement!

We are proud to be endorsing Mike Collins for the US Senate Seat in Georgia. Mike Collins has an amazing A Grade on our own scorecard. He fits the Georgia vibe and that is shown with him out running Trump by 6 points in his own district.

Congressman Collins has continued to fight for an America First agenda, this patriot leaving the House is sad. However, having more proven America First people in the Senate is necessary for the next steps of a MAGA and America First world.
Mike Collins has our complete and total endorsement!
Ken Paxton would be one of the most conservative US Senators and his ruthless aggression against the Democrats would make him an invaluable asset.
His work as the Texas Attorney General has already been amazing, and we know that Ken Paxton has the guts and the energy to fight the swamp!
Ken Paxton is AMERICA FIRST, and TEXAS FIRST!
We proudly endorse Nate Morris for the Senate Seat in Kentucky! Nate Morris is the America First choice.

His opponents are tied to McConnell, and one has a terrible congressional record, F+ Grade on our scorecard. Nate Morris will break the establishment's hold in Kentucky. Such opportunities for new Senate seats are rare. We must not waste this chance!
Nate Morris has our full endorsement!

Kevin Hern has a very solid B from us and won a 2026 Patriot Award from us! We have long backed Kevin Hern, endorsing his reelection in 2024, and we backed him for GOP Policy Chair (2025). We also would have been quite fond of him being Speaker of the House over McCarthy.
Kevin has fought for America First and will be an upgrade over Mullin. He is a former owner of McDonald's franchises and was one of the only McDonald's franchisees to require full E-Verify.

Kevin has been excellent on immigration his entire career (he is the one to introduce the idea of taxing remittance), he opposes the welfare state, and he stood by Trump in 2020. Common sense, business sense, and no nonsense.
We fully back Kevin Hern and encourage ALL Oklahoma voters to support him! Kevin is America First and Oklahoma First!

John Fleming has had a distinguished career, previously serving as a member of the House of Representatives, as Donald Trump’s White House Deputy Chief of Staff, and currently as the Treasurer of Louisiana.

Fleming is strongly pro–Donald Trump and a committed supporter of America First principles. He has long stood with the pro-life movement, opposes Obamacare, and consistently defends conservative cultural values.

Fleming has also been firm on immigration. He has voted for and co-sponsored bills to end chain migration, reduce the visa lottery, and limit the number of worker visas. He has opposed refugee admissions and refugee assistance programs, supports building the wall, and has consistently pushed to increase interior removals, going as far back as 2009.
We know that Fleming will make a great Senator, and we are proud to back this Louisiana First and America First patriot. Vote Fleming!
We are proud to be endorsing Jon Husted for the US Senate seat in Ohio! Jon was appointed by Governor DeWine, after JD Vance became Vice President.

Jon, since his appointment, has been fighting hard for Americans. He has stood by Ohioans, by funding ICE, standing by farmers, and helping implement tax cuts. Jon has also stood strong against fraud, with helping push bills like the CLOSE Act, and it was Jon who introduced the amendment to the Senate to require photo ID to vote.
Jon will continue to be a great Senator for the State of Ohio. He is America First and Ohio First!
We are backing and will be voting for Ashley Moody this cycle. Ashley has shown he willingness to fight for America First.

Ashley was appointed to fill in for Marco Rubio, after he became Secretary of State, and since then she has done great work for Florida!

Ashley is both MAHA and MAGA, fighting to lower your taxes, and fighting to ensure the food you eat is quality. She has voted for the OBBBA, reduce funding to USAID, cuts to PBS/NPR, and to over $70 billion in budget cuts during the recent Votearama.
Vote for Ashley Moody!
Andy Biggs is a true American Patriot who consistently champions the America First agenda. As one of the six A++ ranked Congressmen in the 118th Congress, his track record speaks volumes.
A former Speaker of the Arizona State Senate, Andy has the experience and leadership necessary to take Arizona to the next level. He has consistently outperformed expectations, even outrunning Trump.

His bold leadership and dedication to the people of Arizona make him the ideal candidate to lead the state as Governor. We stand firmly behind Andy Biggs and offer him our full support as he continues to fight for the values that make America great.
We are proud to be endorsing Tommy Tuberville for Alabama Governor. Senator Tuberville has been an excellent Senator and will be an excellent Governor for the State of Alabama.
Tuberville has our complete and total endorsement! Tuberville will be America First and Alabama First!

endorsements.imageAlt: Ralph Norman, South Carolina Governor Candidate
paragraphs: We are proud to be one of the first organizations to endorse Ralph Norman. Congressman Norman has the best score out of all the South Carolina Congressional Reps, with an amazing A+ Grade from us.
Ralph Norman is a member of the House Freedom Caucus, and a supporter of the creation of the State of South Carolina's House Freedom Caucus.
Norman has our total and complete endorsement! Norman has always stood for an America First Agenda.
Burt Jones has a great career in Georgia and he has always fought to make the state better. He has done great work as the Lieutenant Governor and will continue to fight for Georgia First.
When sworn in as Lieutenant Governor, he sought extra funding for schools, eliminating the state income tax, and routinely fought for a better Georgia.
Burt Jones has our complete and total endorsement! As Trump said, Burt Jones is a "Warrior".
Tom Tiffany has a proven conservative record, earning a B+ on our scorecard, the highest of any Wisconsin Congressional Representative.
He’s an over-performer and has a great record. Exactly the kind of candidate who can flip the Governor’s Mansion next year.
Tom Tiffany has our complete and total endorsement! No one is better prepared to fight for Wisconsin families and lead the state forward.

endorsements.imageAlt: Jon Hansen, South Dakota Governor Candidate
paragraphs: We are proud to be endorsing Jon Hansen for Governor of South Dakota. Jon has long been an important part of South Dakota realigning with America First.

Jon has a great track record, having been a strong defender of pro-life and the 2nd Amendment. Jon has defended the property rights of South Dakotans, and fought to keep South Dakota's taxes low. 

Jon has great experience having been a long time member of the South Dakota State House, and even chaired the Judiciary chair for them. More importantly Jon is a fighter, having been involved in the state legislator revolution that helped upgrade South Dakota greatly.
Jon faces against Dusty Johnson a terrible Congressman who should not be South Dakota's next governor.
Jon is the America First and South Dakota first candidate for governor.
Toby came in first place in the South Dakota Governor race and now faces off against the incumbent governor, who previously served as lieutenant governor.
Toby has shown his commitment to South Dakota, fighting for conservatives across the state, while his opponent, the current governor, has largely sat on the sidelines.

Nothing demonstrates this more clearly than the Sioux Falls mayoral race that concluded last night. Toby was out campaigning and supporting the Republican-aligned candidate, while his opponent remained absent. This is the largest city in the state, and as of now, the Republican-aligned candidate is ahead by just two votes. A recount could change the results here.

Without a doubt, had Toby's opponent shown up and campaigned, Republicans would be leading comfortably, instead of hoping that a recount doesn't lead to the State's biggest city falling to the radical left.
Now is not the time for inaction. Toby is the active conservative in this race, willing to fight to keep South Dakota great, while his opponent appears content to manage decline.
Toby is backed by Turning Point Action, and now by us. He is the South Dakota First candidate in this race.
Vote for Toby Doeden!
Oklahoma is one of the most conservative states in the nation, and we believe it deserves leadership that reflects its values. That is why we support Mike Mazzei for Governor.

Mike Mazzei has been a strong advocate for rural Oklahoma, standing up for farmers, ranchers, and small communities. He understands the importance of protecting Oklahoma land from outside interests and ensuring that rural families have a voice in state government.

Mike is committed to strengthening families, supporting faith communities, and preserving the values that have made Oklahoma strong. He believes in economic growth, educational opportunity, and policies that put Oklahoma citizens first.
We believe Mike Mazzei is the best candidate to lead Oklahoma forward and build on the success that many conservative-led states have achieved.
Vote for the Oklahoma First candidate. Vote Mike Mazzei for Governor.
We are endorsing Marsha Blackburn for Tennessee Governor! Tennessee has taken great strives in becoming a leading Red state, under Governor Bill Lee.
Now is the time for the state to continue on that path. Marsha has an A on our scorecard, and Marsha has a history of being a solid senator. She will do great things as governor of Tennessee!
Vote for the Tennessee First candidate. Vote Marsha Blackburn for Governor.
We are proud to endorse James Uthmeier for Attorney General. Since taking office, James has already proven he can win important fights with the law.
The Attorney General's office is one of the most critical positions in any state cabinet, and we have far too few true fighters in this role. James Uthmeier is one of the very best.
Total and complete endorsement!
The Texas Attorney General position is the largest conservative law office in the nation. Ken Paxton used his position to fight for Texas and for America every single day.
Today, we are endorsing Chip Roy to be Texas’s next Attorney General. Some might not know this, but Chip Roy was an assistant Attorney General under Ken Paxton in 2014.

While Roy has had some disagreements with President Trump, he has consistently fought for America First since 2016. Roy has the second-best record in Texas, with an A+ on our scorecard, only bested by freshman Brandon Gill.

Roy has the experience, the fight, and will be an asset for America if elected as Texas’s next Attorney General.
Chip Roy is the sponsor of the SAVE Act. He has voted to realign America’s position on the global stage, fought against woke agendas during the Biden years, and is staunchly anti-illegal immigration.
We believe Chip Roy as Attorney General will be beneficial to all of America. Chip Roy is America First and Texas First!

As Ken Paxton’s deputy, Aaron Reitz personally helped lead dozens of lawsuits against the Biden Administration, including a Day One lawsuit to stop Biden’s unconstitutional 100-day deportation freeze. He understands that the Attorney General’s office exists to fight, not to manage decline.

We had a great conversation with Aaron, and he knows the Texas Attorney General cannot be just anyone. This is a battlefield office, and Texans need a proven warrior.

President Trump nominated Aaron to a Senate-confirmed DOJ position, and when Ken Paxton launched his Senate campaign, Paxton made clear that Aaron was the one person he trusted to carry the torch. That level of confidence speaks for itself.

Aaron knows Texas must work with the Trump Administration to secure the border, but he also knows cooperation alone is not enough. One of the strongest ideas he shared with us was Texas partnering directly with the DOJ to investigate and prosecute H-1B visa abuse and fraud. That approach should be the national standard for Republican Attorneys General. H-1B visas have become a very strong issue, and as long as the Legislative Branch fails to take action, it is up to other avenues to handle the problem.

As Attorney General, Aaron Reitz would also be a national leader. The Texas AG’s office is one of the largest and most powerful red-state law offices in the country, capable of stopping federal overreach and blocking abuses from any future Democratic administration, and Aaron already has the experience to do so.
We are confident Aaron Reitz is the man for the job. He is Texas First and America First. Vote Reitz.

We proudly endorse Don Huffines
 for Texas Comptroller. As a state senator, Don Huffines excelled in pushing a Texas First agenda daily for the GOP. Huffines is an ideal candidate for Comptroller, including his calls to introduce a Texas DOGE to reduce costs and save taxpayers money. His announcement highlights many of the important problems in Texas financially and he will do a great job!
Fully endorsed!

endorsements.imageAlt: Blaise Ingoglia, Florida Chief Financial Officer
paragraphs: Current Chief Financial Officer, Blaise Ingoglia, has announced a run for a full term. Blaise has our complete and total endorsement!

When Blaise was a part of the state legislature, he constantly stood for America First and Florida First ideas, and in his short time as the state's CFO, he has already worked for the average Floridian. From cutting wasteful spending to seeing what can be done about the insurance crisis, Blaise will be able to do so much more with a full term!
Fully endorsed!

endorsements.imageAlt: Alexander Kolodin, Arizona Secretary Of State
paragraphs: Alex is the best candidate for the spot and has already begun gathering significant momentum. Not because Alex is a squishy moderate who will bow to the uniparty, but rather because Alex has already proven he will stand for Arizona First.
Alex has already been involved in the Election Integrity battles, and is a member of the Arizona House Freedom Caucus, and we look forward to seeing him be Arizona's next Secretary of State.
KOLODIN IS AMERICA FIRST, AND ARIZONA FIRST!

endorsements.imageAlt: Robert Sprague, Ohio Secretary Of State
paragraphs:
We are proud to endorse Robert Sprague
 for the Secretary of State for Ohio. Robert has been an excellent State Auditor and has done wonders for Ohio. From protecting your dollars to protecting your vote, Robert will do a fantastic job!
We are proud to be joining Vice President JD Vance on endorsing Jay Edwards for Ohio State Treasurer. Senator Moreno has also endorsed Jay Edwards.

Jay Edwards is an Ohio first patriot, who will do great work as the state treasurer. Jay has experience saving Ohioans money, as he previously sponsored and passed a multibillion dollar tax cut. Jay will do great things!

We are proud to endorse Frank LaRose
 for Auditor of the State of Ohio. Frank LaRose is endorsed by great conservatives such as Jim Jordan and LaRose has endorsed great ideas for the Auditor of the State office to implement. He has our endorsement!
Despite the naming scheme, the Texas Railroad Commissioner is essentially the Energy and Oil Commissioner for the state of Texas, which is one of the biggest producers of Energy.

As we head in 2026 and beyond, with energy prices being of concern as data centers soak up electricity, it is vital that our production of energy picks up, and fast. It is in this context that we feel that Bo French is the best man for the job in such a important position.

There is no one more dedicated top unleashing American Energy in Texas, than Bo. Not only will he unleash the American Energy, but Bo is also committed to stopping the CCP from getting involved in the American Oil industry to safe guard our nation.
Bo is America First, Texas First, and Unleashing Energy First!

endorsements.imageAlt: David Clark, Georiga Lieutenant Governor endorsement
paragraphs:
David is a battle tested conservative, who is a great fit for the state of Georgia! David went from high school straight into the military, in which he served in active combat and eventually joined a select group of people on this planet able to call themselves a Green Beret.

Afterwards David was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2015, and he fought hard for Georgia then, and he will fight hard for Georgia if elected.

During his time in the state legislature, he helped on bills that banned foreign adversaries on farmland, and helped on the Riley Gaines Act. 

As LT. Gov of Georgia, David would be working hand and hand with the State Senate to push for a great agenda, and bills that David wants include, Property Tax Relief, Eliminate State Income Tax, increase School Choice, and reform Education to end DEI locally.

David is also against the Hollywood Tax Credits, that have done nothing but import Hollywood liberals into the state of Georgia. 

David backs local communities in their fights with Data Centers, the multi billion dollar companies must pay their own way, ensuring that locals feel no utility rate hikes, and they do not need any incentives.

Combined with his history of being pro-life, and pro 2nd Amendment, David will ensure that Georgia keeps it's traditional roots. 

David is also pro-expanding State's fight on immigration. Obviously including being pro 287(g) (Local police cooperation with ICE) and pro banning H-1Bs from getting jobs that are funded by the state government, such as universities hiring foreign TAs.
David is America First, but more importantly, David is one hundred percent Georgia First, and we strongly encourage all of our friends to vote David Clark in the primary!
Zach Lahn won the Republican primary for Iowa governor in an upset because he listened to Iowa.
Zach is a strong supporter of rural Iowa and is committed to keeping rural communities thriving. He supports barring out-of-state investors and foreign governments from purchasing Iowa farmland.

As governor, Zach will use the powers of the office to pursue antitrust action against agricultural monopolies, develop plans to support young farmers, and prevent the use of eminent domain for private gain.

Zach also seeks to revitalize Iowa's education system and Make Iowa Healthy Again. His agenda includes expanding safety testing, improving access to clean water, and holding companies accountable for the damage they cause.
He also stands for core conservative principles. Zach is pro-life, focused on making Iowa more affordable, and committed to ensuring that illegal immigrants receive no taxpayer-funded benefits.
Zach Lahn will be a fantastic governor for Iowa, and he is the Iowa First candidate in this race.
Vote Zach Lahn.
Brian is an excellent candidate to be Georgia's next Attorney General. He has fought hard for America First, and has done very good work in the State Senate.
Brian is America First, but more importantly, Brian is one hundred percent Georgia First!

endorsements.imageAlt: Stephen Goldfinch, South Carolina AG endorsement
paragraphs: Attorney Generals are a key part of red states actually wielding power. Attorney Generals such as Paxton and Uthmeier have done great things not only for their state's but for the nation as a whole.

This is why we believe Stephen is the best candidate for the position. Stephen is a member of the SC State Senate who has pushed for great ideas while in the State Senate.

Out of the three candidates for SC AG, Stephen is certainly the best option. He wants to push for SC to be further involved in assisting the Trump Admin on deportations. Stephen is also pro-life and pro 2nd amendment and will carry those values onto the AG's office.
Stephen is the South Carolina first option! Vote for him!

endorsements.imageAlt: Greg Dolezal, Georgia LT Governor endorsement
paragraphs:
Greg was first elected to the State Senate in 2018 and has been a great member of the chamber, serving as part of Georgia's Freedom Caucus.

We spoke with Greg, and after our conversation, we believe he is a great fit to be Georgia's next Lieutenant Governor. Greg believes local communities should have a say in data center construction and that data centers must help reinforce the electrical grid to account for their increased power demands.

Greg also believes it is high time for Georgia to stop bailing out industries. He opposes tax abatements for both the film industry and data centers. Instead, he wants to restructure Georgia's tax system to be more like Florida's by cutting homestead property taxes and lowering the income tax rate, while offsetting the cost by ending these abatements.

Greg wants to ensure that 287(g) agreements are mandatory throughout Georgia. In case you don't know, the Lieutenant Governor of Georgia has significant influence over what legislation advances because they often serve as the presiding officer of the State Senate. Using those powers, Greg would also like to see sovereign immunity removed for cities and counties that do not cooperate with immigration enforcement. This would allow citizens who are harmed by an illegal immigrant who should have been deported, but was not due to a sanctuary policy, to sue the local government that failed to follow the law.
Greg also believes it is time for Georgia to prohibit state and local governments from hiring workers through the H-1B visa program.
Now is the time for Georgia to elect strong conservatives so the state can flourish and return to being a solid red state. Vote for Greg!
We are proud to be endorsing Elijah Crane for reelection. Elijah has an outstanding A++ Grade, which only 6 individuals have ever gotten.

Representative Crane has also done great things for his district. Fighting tooth and nail for AZ-02. He is strong on the border, strong on America First values, and is willing to stand up to the uniparty parts of the GOP House.
Complete and Total Endorsement!

endorsements.imageAlt: Anna Paulina Luna, FL-13 Reelection endorsement
paragraphs: We are proud to be endorsing Anna Paulina Luna for reelection. Anna has an outstanding A++ Grade, which only 6 individuals have ever gotten.

Representative Luna has fought for America First ideas, and has been a leading member on transparency in the government. Her ideas and commitment to America First has her as a leading force in the future of the America First future.
Complete and Total Endorsement!

Andy has been a fantastic representative, who has fought fearlessly for America First policies. He remains one of the strongest voices against all forms of destructive immigration, be it legal or not.
Andy understands that America is made up of a culture that can be change by illegals, and legal immigrants and the devastation that would have on our nation.

However, he isn't just focused on immigration (where he has been fantastic!). Andy understands all future issues we may be having. Andy recently using the powers as Sub Chairman has directed the Homeland Security Subcommittee on Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Protection to review the problems AI maybe causing in the near future.
Andy is in it for the long game to protect America and we fully back his reelection, as one of the best in Congress!

We will be endorsing 
Lance Gooden! Lance has been a solid vote for America First. He currently has a B Grade Lifetime, and that puts him well above the average Congressman!
We hope to see him continue down this line of being great, and hope to see him earn an A!
Complete Endorsement!

We are endorsing 
Michael Cloud for reelection! Representative Cloud has long been a standout on our scorecard,  one of the 30-something Representatives with an A- or higher.
We are excited to see what the future holds for him!
Complete Endorsement!
We are endorsing Keith Self for reelection as well! Keith has earned a stellar A Grade from us and has been such a fighter for America First!
We are excited to seeing what he will be able to do in the 120th Congress!
Complete Endorsement!

Congressman Brandon Gill has been an incredible fighter for the America First movement. He consistently demonstrates both the knowledge to vote for the right bills and the ability to effectively push the messaging for those ideas.

His takes and ability to push for an America First immigration policy has been great, he also has shown he does not fear the RINOs, and as we move into an era of governing, we are glad that Brandon will be there.
We were extremely impressed with his first session in Congress and look forward to many more years of his public service.

Congressman Gill is a perfect example of the kind of representative we want to support. Fantastic job, everyone in TX-26, make sure you show up and reelect the America First and Texas First Brandon Gill!
Complete and Total Endorsement!
We are proud to endorse freshman Rep. Pat Harrigan for another term in Congress. Pat has been a fantastic Congressman, and we look forward to many more years of him serving in Congress!
Pat has scored an excellent 95% on our scorecard and has earned our endorsement!
Complete and Total Endorsement!
We are proud to be endorsing Mark Harris in NC-08 for 2026! Mark is one of only 8 Freshman who have agreed with us on 100% on votes! This has earned him our endorsement!
Mark Harris is America First and North Carolina First!
Complete and Total Endorsement!
We are proud to endorse Brad Knott for reelection this cycle! Brad has been doing great in his R+17 district, and we want him to continue being a valuable asset in the House.
He has scored 95% this cycle from us, and we believe he can keep it up!
Complete and Total Endorsement!
We are proud to be endorsing Addison McDowell for reelection in NC-06! Addison also has earned a 95% from us this session, and he has proven himself to be a great asset in the House.
We are looking forward to his reelection in his R+17 district!
Complete and Total Endorsement!

We are proud to be endorsing Mary Miller for the 2026 cycle! Mary has been an excellent Congresswoman. Receiving an America First Champion award from us this year, and no one fights harder for families than her!
She has our complete and total endorsement!

We are proud to be endorsing Michael Rulli, for reelection this cycle. Michael has done great work as a member of Congress, and has filed several great bills, and has worked harder for his constituents.
We hope to see him win again this year, and continue his America First, and Ohio First record!
We are proud to once again be backing Scott Perry for reelection. Scott is an America First warrior, who has consistently taken the right stance on nearly every bill that falls before him.
Scott holds an impressive A+ with our scorecard over his many years of service to the people of Pennsylvania, and we encourage everyone in PA-10, to help him out this cycle, and make sure he wins!
He has our complete and total endorsement!
We are proud to be endorsing Riley Moore for reelection to WV-02. Riley has been an America First patriot, recently urging the DHS to end OPT, STEM-OP, and CPT.
Riley has fought for his voters, and in doing so has earned an A+ from us so far! He has a very bright future, and can't wait to see him win again!
Riley is America First, and West Virginia First!
We are proud to be endorsing Clay Higgins for reelection. Clay has consistently fought for the truth, and has fought for America First and Louisiana First ideas.
He has our complete and total endorsement!
We are proud to be endorsing Andrew Clyde for reelection. Andrew has consistently fought for the truth, and has fought for America First and Georgia First ideas.
He has our complete and total endorsement!
We backed Clay Fuller in the second round of the GA-14 special, and since his victory he has proven to be a great Congressman so far! We look forward to seeing more of his career in Congress.
He has our complete and total endorsement!

We are also endorsing great patriot Russell Fry for reelection! Russell has been a great fighter in Congress, earning a Patriot Award from us, and having been a great voice against harmful immigration.
Vote for Russell Fry!
We are endorsing Sheri Biggs for reelection. As a freshman she has been solid! Having an A+ on our scorecard and an A+ on NumbersUSA!
Vote for Sheri Biggs!
We are also endorsing William Timmons for reelection. Williams has been solid, earning a Patriot award from us, and has been solid, but not proactive on immigration.
Still, we think Williams has been decent and look forward to another term!

We are endorsing Tim Burchett for reelection! Tim has been an excellent Congressman, winning a Patriot Award from us. Tim has also provided great transparency into what's happening in the halls of Congress.
Vote for Burchett!

endorsements.imageAlt: Matt Van Epps, TN-07 Reelection endorsement
paragraphs: We are also endorsing Matt Van Epps for reelection. Since winning the special election, Matt has been very solid. He has earned a B on our scorecard, but he has been a fighter on immigration.
Earning a A+ on NumbersUSA and has taken aggressive stances against immigration. We look forward to Matt serving another term!
We are PROUD to be endorsing Brandon Herrera. We had a wonderful conversation with Brandon and we know he is the right guy for TX-23. The current incumbent has a D on our America First Scorecard.

Brandon will be different. We are confident that he will stand up for America. Brandon will also be an invaluable asset on the fight on immigration and protecting the 2nd Amendment. Last cycle he lost the primary by less than 500 votes, while being massively outspent. The people want him in Congress.

He will fight for keeping America, America. He will fight to keep the 2nd Amendment protected, and there is no one better suited for refitting (or defunding) the ATF than Mr.Herrera. He also understands the struggle the modern VA has, and will work to help fix it.
Brandon Herrera is TEXAS FIRST, and AMERICA FIRST. He has our complete and total endorsement in TX-23!
We are proud to endorse Steve Toth for Congress. Steve has been an outstanding member of the Texas State House, and we believe he is the right person to primary Dan Crenshaw.

Steve has consistently voted for America First policies, strongly supported the Second Amendment, fought for election integrity, and remains one of the most conservative members of the Texas legislature.
Dan Crenshaw has not been America First. He has an F+ on our scorecard and has consistently failed to stand up for America.
Therefore, Steve Toth has our complete and total endorsement!

Craig Haggard is a member of the Indiana State Legislature who is running against incumbent Jim Baird (C- Grade on our scorecard).

Jim Baird co-sponsored Maria Salazar's terrible Dignity Act, which would hamper mass deportations, and grant amnesty to millions of illegals in effect.

Craig is a strong supporter of the 2nd Amendment, pro-life, and deporting illegals. 

Craig is a farmer and a veteran, he knows the struggles both groups go through, and he offers real solutions to their issues. He will be an excellent asset to the House GOP.
Vote for Craig Haggard! He is Indiana First and America First!
Phil is a proven fighter for Utah. Phil previously ran for Governor of Utah, winning the endorsement of the delegates but ultimately losing 45-54% to Governor Cox.

Phil understands Utah. He knows that the rural communities and the state as a whole needs to be protected. From the water rights to the ranchers, to the energy production Phil has a plan.

Phil opposes H-1B visas and other temporary worker visa programs, along with backing nationwide E-Verify. Phil also stands by the nuclear family publicly and will push for it to stay the standard.

Phil is running against a terrible incumbent, Celeste Maloy, who has a terrible D on our scorecard. Phil will be a much stronger fighter for America First ideas than Maloy is. So Phil Lyman has our endorsement in the race!

Karianne is a proud local candidate in the new UT-02, running to bring strong, principled leadership to Washington. In a solid R+30 district, Utah deserves a representative who reflects its values and fights effectively for its people.

She has earned the support of numerous local state representatives and a growing grassroots coalition that believes in her vision for Utah’s future.

Karianne is a strong supporter of the Second Amendment, staunchly Pro-Life, and committed to securing our border and taking decisive action to dismantle cartel activity. She also supports the MAHA movement and efforts to improve the safety and quality of America’s food supply.

On energy, Karianne advocates for pro-production policies that ensure America’s long-term economic strength and energy independence. She is also a firm defender of parental rights, believing that families, not the federal government, should lead decisions about their children’s upbringing and education.

Having fought for these values in the Utah State Legislature, Karianne is ready to take that same determination to Congress.
She is America First. She is Utah First. Vote Karianne for Congress.

Ed Gallrein is attempting to primary Thomas Massie, and we encourage any voter in KY-04 to vote for Ed. Will Ed be a generational candidate that will fundamentally change Congress? No. Will Ed be an decent backbencher? Yes, and that’s an upgrade over Massie.

This endorsement is more of an anti-Massie endorsement than anything else.

Starting with Massie’s voting record: We will inevitably see posts about his Freedom Index score of ninety-whatever. Scorecards measure what they want, and the Freedom Index puts a heavy emphasis on debt, the Constitution, and freedom. That’s great for a libertarian.

However, the Freedom Index does not list the OBBBA as a vote, which is a key point. The OBBBA is representative of the new Republican Party. We will deport illegals at any cost, and we must. Thomas Massie voted against the OBBBA, has voted against the Secure Our Border Act, has taken a stance against E-Verify, and against Real ID. Massie also voted for an amendment to force judicial warrants on ICE, which is a massive slowdown on deportation efforts.

Massie also cosponsored the “Fairness for High-Skilled Immigrants Act,” which would remove the per-country cap on employment-based immigrant visas. The number one beneficiary of this would be India, by a very large margin.

The end result of Massie’s votes is pro-immigration. He counters this by sponsoring and cosponsoring good bills, but when the opportunity comes, he votes in suboptimal ways, such as when he voted to block Trump’s use of emergency funds to build the wall in 2019.

Massie also stood up for MIT when they wanted to keep letting men into women’s restrooms (by wanting to keep federal funding going to them. Where is his “all funding should be cut” attitude?). Actually wielding power is a Libertarian’s kryptonite. Massie was also against blowing up narco boats.

Next is his general incompetence as a Congressman. Massie has had very few big accomplishments in all his years in Congress. First, he delayed the vote on Covid emergency funding. He didn’t change the vote, just delayed it for a few days. His most recent accomplishment is doing the same thing: delaying the FISA temporary renewal for a few hours. Massie also insists everything must be single-issue bills, which is politically awful.

Guess what happens if you split the OBBBA into single-issue bills? Literally everything liberal would pass, and nothing conservative would. Do you honestly believe that if the OBBBA was broken up, the bill called “Spending Money to Deport all Illegals” would pass? Massie, Salazar, Bacon, Fitzpatrick, and probably a few more would all vote no. The end result would not be a more based America. It would be an America without the money to deport all illegals.

Massie’s other two big successes are straight-up terribly written. His role in suspending the Debt Ceiling for Joe Biden featured a terribly written enforcement mechanism, after which he blamed House GOP leadership rather than the bad bill itself. Why would Democrats vote for something that could lead to welfare cuts? They wouldn’t. They knew the bill was badly written. The same goes for the wording on the Epstein Files Bill. It was poorly written. It did not overturn common law restrictions on releasing certain types of communications, and Massie just couldn’t comprehend that, but hey we got unverified/false FBI tips entering the public discussion!

Then there is the fact that Massie might be the biggest two-faced politician in the nation. He calls the Trump Admin the “Epstein Admin” while making ads implying he loves Trump to his primary voters. He literally hung out with “victims” who were calling Trump a pedophile, and a few months later sent out mailers saying he backs Trump. He will show a 10-year-old tweet where Charlie Kirk liked him, then thank Candace Owens for her endorsement, and retweet someone who called Charlie a pedophile. Massie also literally campaigned for Mitch McConnell.

Massie also receives endorsements and donations from leftists. Cenk is a huge endorser of Massie. When has the left ever purposefully moved against their own interests? They always hate and attempt to destroy those who threaten Democrat control. Massie clearly is not a threat. He has consistently voted against censuring or stripping committees from radical leftists, including Schiff in 2023, Tlaib in 2023, and Omar in 2025 (after Omar mocked Charlie’s assassination). Massie also blamed Trump’s rhetoric for Charlie’s assassination while continuing to paint himself as Trump’s BFF. He takes money from IPAC, a group of Democratic Socialists who oppose ICE, and he knows exactly who they are. He flew to PA to meet their chairman. He is also backed by the Mahrouq family, which supports Omar, Tlaib, Lee, Bush, and Massie. When asked why he works with Democrats, he said, “Well no joke, when you are against the Uni-party, you need a unity party.” There is no unity with the left. There never will be. They hate America, and they hate you. He gets all this leftist support while claiming to be MAGA’s strongest warrior in his district.

It should be crystal clear that as much as Massie paints himself as a non-politician, there is no one who acts more like a lying politician than Massie. He offers no real political solutions, wants to prevent conservative legislation with terrible political skills, and consistently fights against whoever is in government, except when Joe Biden needs the debt ceiling suspended. Thomas Massie’s party identification is simply a byproduct of him wanting to be elected. If Massie was so independent and so popular, why wouldn’t he run as a Libertarian? Is it because they suck, and thus he must mask himself as a Republican?

We have Massie at a C+ on our scorecard. There is room for improvement. However, unlike most of the other Cs on our scorecard, if the House Majority was 218-217 with Massie as our swing vote, we would not have gotten the largest funding of ICE ever, we would not have gotten the 2017 Tax Cuts made into law, we would never get E-Verify, we would have not gotten to tax on overtime and tips, we would have not gotten wall funding, and more. At least the other Cs can be bullied into being on the correct side. Massie’s principles magically disappear when he can suddenly hamper the right. He objectively helps the left, and will continue to do so, while calling himself Trump’s biggest soldier.
With all that said, vote for Ed.
We are proud to endorse Briscoe Cain for the open TX-09 seat! Briscoe is a great representative, and after our conversation, we are confident he will be an outstanding member of Congress.

Briscoe currently serves in the Texas House for District 128 and chairs the Texas Freedom Caucus. He is consistently one of the strongest America First voices in the Texas House. His actions in the state house speaks for themselves, and Briscoe Cain will put Texas First and put America First once inside Congress.
He has our complete and total endorsement!
We are glad to endorse Tom Sell for TX-19. Tom is exactly the kind of candidate we look for: someone who will represent the District and represent America!

TX-19 is an extremely rural and agriculture-based district, and Tom himself is not only a rancher but previously worked in DC under Larry Combest. Larry Combest chaired the House Committee on Agriculture, and Tom worked under him at that time.

This means Tom already knows how to write complex agricultural legislation, and that matters. Plenty of great candidates have excellent ideas, but already having the knowledge to implement those policies is crucial. Tom understands the struggles of farmers and ranchers. He knows what red tape, from agriculture or small business, suffocates the American Dream.

Tom is also strong on core America First priorities: stopping illegal immigration, achieving American energy dominance, defending the Second Amendment, and keeping America American.

Tom brings experience and real relief to small business owners, farmers, and ranchers, making him an excellent fit for the district!
Tom Sell is America First and Texas First! He has our complete and total endorsement!

Joe Mitchell is a former member of the Iowa State House who only lost after being redistricted out. He founded Run Gen Z (a great organization) and has consistently been a powerful voice for Gen Z Republicans.
Joe worked on Trump's 2024 transition team and served as a regional administrator for HUD. He also owns a real estate company focused on developing housing in rural communities.

Joe understands the importance of forgotten groups like rural America and Gen Z. He has the administrative and housing experience to help solve America's housing crisis, the most important part of the American Dream. He also understands the struggles of Iowans and will be outstanding representation for Iowa.
Joe Mitchell will put Iowa first and America first. Vote for Joe!

Following the upcoming redistricting, Ezekiel Enriquez has moved to run in TX-21 (Chip Roy's seat). Ezekiel not only is an America First patriot, someone we know is willing to put TEXAS and AMERICA First, but Ezekiel has strong ties to the new TX-21, having been a firefighter in the new TX-21 for many years.

As a true America First candidate, Ezekiel stands strong on every issue that matters to the American people—securing our borders, defending the Second Amendment, protecting families, and fighting for our Veterans.
We are proud to give our endorsement to Ezekiel Enriquez in TX-21!

Jon has years of experience in the mortgage business. He states that he understands where the red tape and issues lie in people getting mortgages to buy their homes.

As we look toward furthering our goal of becoming a governing coalition, the ability to solve the housing crisis is very important. Jon's experience will be invaluable in this effort.

Jon has been endorsed by great people, including Brandon Gill, Eric Burlison, and Mary Miller, all of whom score very highly on our scorecard.

Wesley Hunt has given up his seat to run for Senate. With Hunt holding an excellent A+ on our scorecard, it is vital that whoever fills TX-38 is on par with him, and we believe that Jon Bonck is the man for the job.
We are proud to give our endorsement to Jon Bonck in TX-38!
We will be supporting Wyoming's current Secretary of State, Chuck Gray for Congress. We had a great conversation with Chuck, and we believe he is the right man for the job.

Chuck being a Secretary of State understands how to get Voter ID, and proof of citizenship laws written and implemented. Chuck also has never shied away from a fight. Whether locally in Wyoming, or amongst its neighbors, Chuck has always stood up for Wyoming. Despite how red Wyoming is, America First ideas were sparse for years. It was Chuck and his roles helping the Wyoming Freedom Caucus really help turn Wyoming into a much better state. He also helped sue when the states of Oregon and Washington refused to allow Wyoming to export coal to their markets.

Chuck being a former member of the Wyoming State Legislature is well versed on energy, such as oil, coal, and natural gas, all huge exports for Wyoming. He knows what reforms are needed to unleash American Energy and secure America's independence from foreign supply chains. This not only is a matter of national security, but will be great for keeping American wallets in a good place.
Chuck Gray is America First and Wyoming First. He has our complete and total endorsement!
We had a great discussion with Keith Gross, and we believe he is the best man for the job. When we endorse candidates, we often ask what they can bring to Congress.

Keith is a successful businessman who has seen how U.S. regulations smother American businesses. America must retain its status as the world's greatest place to live, where starting and building your own business is the most American pursuit. Keith can advise Congress on how to make it happen. He is also pro-energy, which will be vital in the coming years as energy costs, driven largely by data centers, hit Americans' wallets hardest. We need to unleash American energy, and Keith supports that.

Keith is staunchly for Americans. He recognizes that H-1B visas are being abused to harm the American middle class. He is a strong supporter of the Second Amendment, of life, of cutting fraud, and of moving America toward a balanced budget.
We are proud to back Keith Gross. He is Florida First and America First.
This is another open safe seat in Texas, and it is important that we get the best possible people in place. For TX-32, that is Jace Yarbrough.

Jace is an America First patriot. He is anti-illegal immigration but, more importantly, opposes the abuse of legal immigration. He knows that American workers suffer due to all forms of immigration. Jace is also strong on other issues, such as the 2nd Amendment, elections and wasteful spending. He knows that America needs to prepare for the future, with out national security needing to be safe, via AI and energy self sufficiency.

Jace is a veteran and a constitutional lawyer who has fought for America First ideas across the nation. He understands firsthand that we need fighters. He volunteered in 2024 as an attorney in Detroit against voter fraud, helping securing Trump's great victory in the State. This seventh-generation Texan has our support!
Jace is America First and Texas First. VOTE JACE!

Jessica is the right pick for TX-08. She formerly worked for the Trump DOJ, where she led efforts to combat human trafficking. She also worked for the America First Policy Institute and has a long history in Texas..

Jessica is strong on protecting children and families, including defending parental rights. She stood up for girls in sports and for secure elections in Texas. She also helped lead an investigation into ActBlue. Her pro-America energy policies are excellent, and she is backed by a wide range of strong supporters.
Jessica has our endorsement! She is America First and Texas First!
We are glad to be endorsing Blake Miguez for Letlow's old seat. Letlow has a D+ on our scorecard, and this seat is red enough that the bare minimum should be an A Grade.

During his time in the state legislature, Blake fought for Constitutional Carry, passed a MAHA Law to ban ultra-processed food in schools, secured elections, and help cut wasteful spending, being part of the Louisiana DOGE Committee.

He also has helped protect women, with a bathroom and sports bill, along with him writing the laws that stopped New Orleans from being a sanctuary city.

He has a proven track record fighting for a better America.
Vote for Blake Miguez, he is Louisiana First and America First!
We spoke to David Flippo and believe he is the best candidate for this congressional district! David has a common-sense America First agenda that is needed in Congress.

David has plenty of experience in the oil industry and in the small business world, both of which are suffocating under federal regulations, and David is an excellent fit in Congress, as he can help cull the regulations halting American Growth!
David knows that America is for Americans, and is not only pro mass-deportations, pro-self deportations, but he is pro reducing H-1Bs, especially in the current job climate.

David also can see the writing on the wall, and that Data Centers must pay for their own ways. They cannot raise utility bills for Americans, and in a state like Nevada especially, they cannot be allowed to guzzle an infinite amount of water. David also stands for the 2nd Amendment, shrinking the government, and reducing our Debt.
We are glad to endorse David, and we know he will be a valuable asset in Congress! David is America First and Nevada First!
We are endorsing Marty for NV-03, as this is a key pickup opportunity for the GOP. Trump won NV-03 by around a point, and we believe that Marty will be a great Congressman!
Marty has been focusing on ensuring the US economy's future is secured, and that as little disturbance occurs as possible. He also stands for strong and secured borders.
He knows that the American Dream is weakening and that Congress must remove the roadblocks and the regulations that are destroying the Dream.
Marty is the America First and Nevada First candidate! Vote for Marty O'Donnell!

We believe that Josh is the best representation of America First in the TX-35 GOP Primary. Josh wants to fight hard to keep Texas Jobs for Texans, to unleashing American energy, and defend parental rights.
Josh is endorsed by quite a few excellent groups in Texas, and we feel confident in joining them in endorsing him!
Vote Josh Cortez, he is America First!

We are proud to be backing Josh Williams. 

Josh has lived in the district for years, is a graduate of the University of Toledo Law School, and has experience on Constitutional Law.

He was elected to the Ohio House of Representatives, and was the House Majority Whip too. 

Josh is pro fighting illegal immigration and supporting ICE, he is pro 2nd Amendment, and is in favor of cutting the waste, the fraud, and the abuse in our government.

Josh backs the ideas of reforming welfare to help encourage independence, and to help make Vocational Training a supported career path for those who need it. 

Josh is against the unfair trade deals, that stole Ohioan's futures and he wants to rebuild the Industry that once called Ohio its home.
Josh has fought hard while in the Ohio State House, and he will continue to fight hard for Ohio and America if elected to Congress. Vote for Josh! He is Ohio First, and America First!

Jackson is a native Oklahoman who entered the political ring in 2020. As Covid forced individuals to take a vaccine or lose their jobs, Jackson used his position in his church to sign tens of thousands of religious exemption slips.

After that Jackson was involved in politics, running in 22 against incumbent Lankford. While he did not win, it was a catalyst to keep him in politics. During 2024, he lead the Pastors For Trump group.

Jackson in our conversation, announced his intentions on work visas, to put it simply it's Americans First. He would vote to lower the number of H-1Bs at a minimum, and would like to see OPT also capped as a minimum (if it still exists). 

Jackson is very pro-life, and a strong supporter of the 2nd Amendment. Jackson also thinks that local communities deserve a say on whether or not a Data Center can be built in their towns, and that Data Centers must pay for their own way. Expanding both the electric and water infrastructures.

Jackson in his time campaigning back in 22, has already gained great insight on what Oklahomans need, and as such, Jackson is committed to fixing the Meatpacking Monopoly, that devastates American Ranchers.  Another fix on the meatpacking industry is fixing a egregious loophole. You can import foreign meat, and if you pack it in America, you can have a Made in USA sticker, which while not Product of USA sticker, it still can be confusing for consumers.

We think Jackson with his bold leadership in the past and doing what was right, that Jackson will be a great asset in Congress. Jackson is America First, Oklahoma First, and Tulsa First. Vote for Jackson!
Houston Gaines will be an excellent Congress who will fight for America First, and Georgia First! He has been great in the Georgia House of Representatives and look forward to him being in Congress!
Vote Houston Gaines, he is America First!

Rob is a fighter for conservative values. He is pro-life and he is a massive supporter of the 2nd Amendment.

Rob is a supporter of ensuring that Americans & their opportunities are protected from legal immigration. Rob is also common sense supporter, saying that our borders must be sealed and dangerous policies such as catch and release must never comeback.

Rob also understands the Christian values that are centered to our Republic. He will fight for American culture, fight to protect our rights, and he will fight for a better America!

Rob is also endorsed by Turning Point Action.
Vote for the Georgia First and America First option! VOTE FOR ROB!
Marty has served as the South Dakota Attorney General for some time and has done solid work there. President Trump has endorsed Marty and we also believe that Marty will be solid.
Marty Jackley is America First and South Dakota First. Vote for Marty!

Mark Smith is looking to fill Nancy Nace's open seat and we think Mark is a great fit.

Mark is pro ensuring Data Centers pay their fair share, to reinforce the grid so that families don't feel the stress.

Mark's record in the State House and been very solid, fighting illegal immigration, backing the blue, and defending our rights.

Mark knows that America must be affordable, and it must bring back manufacturing jobs. Mark has already greatly lowered taxes in South Carolina, and he will continue to fight for a slim, efficient, and effective government.
Mark Smith is Lowcountry First, South Carolina First, and America First!
We are proud to be backing Wes Climer for SC-05! Wes is backed by Ralph Norman to be his replacement, and we have high hopes!
Wes Climer is the candidate! Vote for Wes!

We had the opportunity to speak with Daniel and we believe he will be fantastic in Congress. Daniel was born and raised in Arizona’s 5th Congressional District (AZ-05), and has experience in farming, ranching, and homebuilding.

Daniel is a conservative on the 2nd Amendment, parental rights, and abortion. Daniel also has a lot of experience owning a small business and building homes, meaning once in Congress, Daniel will know exactly how to cut regulations so small businesses and America can thrive.

Daniel is also great on immigration. Daniel understands that mass deportations and lowering the number of legal immigrants on visas is how we can recover the housing market, and make housing affordable. Akin to that Daniel is pro mandating E-Verify, and wants to end the H-1B program and OPT. In our conversation Daniel understood that the future of Americans is being sold to the cheapest foreign workers, and that damage must be undone.

Daniel also follows a common-sense, realistic America First foreign policy and strongly opposes NGOs. Daniel will be a great representative in Congress, who will continue Arizona Republicans’ strong record of America First leadership. From understanding the threats of immigration, to his practical understanding of modern regulations, Daniel will be an asset to the House GOP going forward.
Daniel is the America First option in the race. Vote Daniel Keenan!
We are proud to be endorsing Anthony Bonna for the open Florida State House District 85, a Port St. Lucie based seat.

Anthony’s record of service speaks for itself. In 2018, he was appointed to the St. Lucie County Commission, and later went on to serve as a City Councilman for Port St. Lucie. Under his leadership, the city achieved a 10% reduction in taxes in just 3 years, all while continuing its rapid growth as Florida’s 6th largest city.

Beyond his local leadership, Anthony has been a strong voice within the Florida GOP. He currently serves as Chairman of the Republican Party of Florida’s State Committeeman and Committeewoman Caucus, where he continues to advocate for conservative values. Anthony will put FLORIDA FIRST and AMERICA FIRST!
Anthony Bonna has our complete and total endorsement!
We are proud to be endorsing Anthony Bonna for the open Florida State House District 85, a Port St. Lucie based seat.
Erin Huntley has done an excellent job leading the Orange County GOP and she is the right person to flip Florida House District 45. She will put Florida First and she has our endorsement!
Erin Huntley has our complete and total endorsement!
We are proud to endorse Lukas Schubert for reelection to the Montana State House! Lukas has been fighting for an America First agenda in Montana and voting for Montana First laws.

We’ve talked with Lukas about his plans for the next legislative session, and he has great ideas, such as increasing punishments for businesses that hire illegals over Americans! Backed by the Montana Freedom Caucus, he has already passed several laws. He has a bright future in politics, starting with his reelection next year!
Lukas has our complete and total endorsement in his race, he is America First and Montana First!

We are proud to endorse Brian Harrison for reelection in Texas House District 10! Brian Harrison has been a great member of the Texas GOP and Texas State House, representing Ellis County well since 2021.

Brian has fought tooth and nail for a more conservative Texas since he was first elected. He has also provided amazing transparency to the behind-the-scenes of Texas politics. Brian has successfully gotten Texas A&M to properly follow Texas law when it came to the standard curriculum, and recently has essentially single-handedly got Texas to clamp down on issuing DLs to illegals.
Brian is Texas First and America First!

We are endorsing Kenny Cody for Tennessee State House District 11. This is an open Trump +68 district in Eastern Tennessee.

Kenny has long been involved in GOP politics, including being the Chair of the Cocke County GOP. Kenny is a teacher in the district however, he has spent years being a prominent voice in the GOP. He has been an active political columnist for years, and has keep his head in politics all that time.

Kenny understands the local issues affecting Tennessee, and he knows that as a state house representative, that he has the power to make his home district great, and to get Tennessee to be the best red state, while ensuring it manages to stay a red state.

He will support the farmers of his district, and ensure that no data centers rob the locals of water, nor raise their utility bills. Combined with his experience in education, he will be a very valuable asset on Education reforms, including pushing for Tennessee to help students who decide to go to trade school.
Kenny is America First, but more importantly in this local election, he is 100% Tennessee First!

endorsements.imageAlt: Trevor De Vries, IN SD-01 endorsement
paragraphs: Indiana state legislation has shown its true colors of being backstabbing RINOs in the past couple of months. Trevor will bring Indiana First and America First ideas to the state legislation that desperately needs it.

We had the pleasure of talking with Trevor and he is committed to the job and will bring a great deal of refreshing ideas to the State Senate. 

Trevor stands for all the important measures, from the Constitution, to MAHA, to being Pro-Life and Pro-Second Amendment. He is the man for the job and we look forward to him being in the State Senate.
Vote Trevor De Vries, for Indiana First and America First representation!
Richard is going against an incumbent in the 22nd Indiana State Senate District, and Richard has our total endorsement.

The incumbent best represents the rot in the Indiana GOP. The incumbent is Ron Alting, who has said he is pro-choice, one of the few votes he regrets voting for was one that helped Christians in the State, he has opposed criminalizing homelessness, voted against Tax Cuts, and coauthored a bill to let illegals have "driving privilege cards."

Richard on the other hand is an America First patriot. Having first gotten involved in politics due to COVID restrictions that were placed on kids in Indiana. Richard also as quite a bit of experience involved on advocating for parent's rights in Indiana, and will be a great voice on that in the State Senate.

Richard has promised to deliver actual conservative results to help Indiana be the best state it could be. This includes making sure data centers won't raise utility bills, fighting for the 2nd Amendment, fighting for the pro-life movement, and ensuring that Indiana is hostile to illegal immigrants so they leave the state.
Richard Bagsby is America First, and Indiana First.
Armin has a great track record, and has a great list of policies ready to push in Texas. While Mayor, he managed to slash taxes, and he will do the same while in the State House.
Armin is also a strong supporter for School Choice, and to continue expanding this great program! Armin is also great on government spending, economic development, and great on the Second Amendment!
This is a Trump +26 State House District, and Armin with his local ties, being mayor of a major part of the district (Keller), and his track record shows he is the right man for the job.

We always state that these state legislator races are important, and this one is no different. Your state legislations probably has a bigger impact on your daily life, than Congress. Armin will help make Texas the best it can be!
Vote for Armin! He is America First, Texas First, and Keller & Grapevine First!

We had an excellent conversation with Christian, this Marine will be an excellent addition to Georgia's state legislature! This district is effected by massive PFAS pollution and Christian will help direct resources to help his district. Christian is also dedicated to the idea of property tax relief for Georgians, and to help build up real infrastructure in the region.

Christian also believes that Data Centers not only need to pay their way, such as ensuring they aren't raising utility bills in local areas, but also that Data Centers should listen to small rural communities, if they are not welcomed.

Christian believes the Film Credits have been a net negative to Georgia, by destroying the culture of much of the state, while also not employing many Georgians, but employing Georgia transplants. Christian also joins a growing movement of having states ban not only state government, but state funded universities from employing H-1B holders. Giving those jobs back to Americans.

Christian is also very pro-homeschool and is a very pro 2nd Amendment. He believes in defending the culture of the state, and defending the culture of the United States. This rural district is also a major manufacturer in the Floor industry and he hopes to see both sides flourish.
Christian Hurd is an America First candidate, a Georgia First candidate, and a Chickamauga/Tunnel Hill First candidate. Vote for Christian Hurd!
We are endorsing Blake Fiechter for SD-19 in Indiana, against an incumbent who voted against redistricting.
Blake has Trump's endorsement, TPAction endorsement, and now the AFI Endorsement.
Vote Blake Fiechter, for Indiana First and America First representation!
We are endorsing Brenda Wilson for SD-38 in Indiana, against an incumbent who voted against redistricting.
Brenda has Trump's endorsement, TPAction endorsement, and now the AFI Endorsement.
Vote Brenda Wilson, for Indiana First and America First representation!
We are endorsing Jeff Ellington for SD-39 in Indiana, this is an open seat, due to the anti-redistricting incumbent retiring.
Jeff has Trump's endorsement, TPAction endorsement, and now the AFI Endorsement..
Vote Jeff Ellington, for Indiana First and America First representation!
We are endorsing Paul Copenhaver for SD-23 in Indiana, against an incumbent who voted against redistricting.
Paula has Trump's endorsement, TPAction endorsement, and now the AFI Endorsement.
Vote Paula Copenhaver, for Indiana First and America First representation!
We are endorsing Tracey Powell for SD-21 in Indiana, against an incumbent who voted against redistricting.
Tracey has Trump's endorsement, TPAction endorsement, and now the AFI Endorsement.
Vote Tracey Powell, for Indiana First and America First representation!
We had the opportunity to talk to Dusty, and we know he is a force of good in Oklahoma. Dusty has been a pioneer in using state legislation to push the right-wing immigration agenda.

Dusty has pushed for bills that would prohibit all state entities from using H-1B and OPT programs, ensuring Americans and Oklahomans take those jobs. In a separate bill he also pushed for state contracts with companies also to be banned from using H-1B and OPT. 

Dusty also pushed for E-Verify in the great state of Oklahoma, and Dusty also introduced a bill to increase the remittance tax.

Dusty also has been a very strong defender of pro-life, 2nd amendment, and low tax agendas. Dusty has also defended parental rights, and fought to help the Oil and Gas industry, which is a very large part of Oklahoma's economy, and is a important part of American energy overall. 

Oklahoma is a insanely ruby red state, yet their state legislation still holds onto a majority of RINOS, but it's close to changing. This year America First and Oklahoma First patriots could take control of the Oklahoma State Senate, and one of the key requirements to that is that Dusty holds onto his seat.
So if you live in SD-32, please vote for the Oklahoma First option, vote Dusty Deevers!

endorsements.imageAlt: Jack Ciattarelli, New Jersey Governor Candidate
paragraphs: We are proud to be endorsing Jack Ciattarelli for New Jersey Governor! Jack Ciattarelli is the perfect representation for New Jersey, and is Trump endorsed.

Back in 2021 Ciattarelli came really close to winning the election. Since then New Jersey has moved significantly to the right, and dissatisfaction with local New Jersey Government is at an all time high!
Jack Ciattarelli has our complete and total endorsement! Ciattarelli will be New Jersey First!

We are proud to endorse Jason Miyares for Attorney General. Jason has consistently fought to keep Law and Order in Virginia. Not to mention the state of Virginia is a critical state to reign in the swamp.
Jason has the opportunity to win reelection in the Harris +6 state of Virginia. His opponent is just a genuinely awful human and shouldn't even be close to the AG office.
Total and complete endorsement!

We proudly announce our endorsement for Jimmy Patronis
 in FL-01! He has our endorsement and Trump's endorsement.
Patronis is the America First option in the upcoming special, and we wholeheartedly believe he will be an excellent congressman!
We are proud to endorse Patronis in FL-01!

We are proud to announce our endorsement of @Aaron4fl6
 for the FL-06 Special Election. We had a wonderful discussion with Aaron and have determined he is the right man for the job. Aaron is the America First choice in Fl-06!
We here at America First Insight are proud to be endorsing Jody Barrett for the TN-07 special election.

Jody is one of the best state legislators in Tennessee, and he has the knowledge and the experience needed in Congress. He understands the important conservative issues that need to be pushed forward, and those that need to be protected.
Jody also has the community roots needed to serve the district well, having been involved in rural county politics for some time, and being a small business owner.
Jody will be an amazing Congressman and will certainly be a upgrade over Mark Green. The primary election is October 7th, 2025, and the general is December 2nd, 2025.
Jody Barrett is AMERICA FIRST and TENNESSEE FIRST. Vote for Jody!
To all our Pennsylvania Patriots, please make sure you VOTE NO this November on all three Judicial retention questions.

The Democrats have controlled the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania since 2015, this year 3 Liberal judges are up. If all three fail to retain, Governor Shaprio can only appoint new judges (until 2027) with approval of the GOP controlled State Senate.
VOTE NO!
We had a fantastic conversation with Dan, and we know he will be an excellent member of the Florida State House.
He will fight for a better Florida, Dan will be fighting hard for an affordable Florida. He will improve the lives of the middle class, and take steps to make Florida even better.
He will defend Tampa, and defend Florida. Vote for Dan!

We had a great chance to speak with Jerry Carl, and we are very excited to see his return to Congress. For those unfamiliar, Alabama was forced to redraw its congressional map in 2023, pitting incumbents Jerry Carl and Barry Moore against each other in a new Mobile-based district.
Jerry Carl lost that race, but now that Barry Moore is running for Senate, this district is open. We believe Jerry is the best man for the job.

Jerry has great and highly relevant experience, and he will be a vital part of a Republican majority. Not only does he have four years of experience serving in Congress, where he understands that the Appropriations Committee is where real budget cuts happen, but he has also served on the Armed Services and Natural Resources Committees.
Jerry also has 40 years of business operations experience, which we believe is always vital. In order to cut regulations, you need to know which ones actually get in the way.

Jerry saw the open Biden border firsthand, and he knows that we must prevent that chaos from ever happening again. He also wants to ensure that the American economy works for Americans. This includes slowing down H-1B visas and stopping the abuse that happens through OPT as well. Jerry was also disappointed in the birthright citizenship decision and believes the majority got it wrong.

Jerry is incredibly pro-life and pro-gun, and he has the experience and leadership needed to be a vital part of a GOP Congress. Jerry has a very solid grade from NumbersUSA, is endorsed by President Trump, and is now endorsed by us.
Alabama patriots, please go vote for Jerry Carl!
We had the opportunity to talk with Dr. Mike Katz, a successful physician who has watched the health care industry bloat into chaos over the course of his career.

Dr. Mike is running for the Senate because he wants to help Republicans deregulate the health care industry and make it affordable again. After spending more than four decades practicing medicine, he has seen firsthand how excessive regulations have driven up costs and made it harder for both doctors and patients.
On the economy, Dr. Mike believes in common-sense fiscal responsibility. He supports cutting wasteful government spending and opposes raising taxes to help protect American families from inflation.
Dr. Mike also understands that a strong energy sector is the foundation of American prosperity. That includes his vocal support for expanding nuclear power, a position we strongly agree with.

Health care reform remains one of the biggest challenges facing the country, and Dr. Mike has put forward serious ideas to address it. His platform includes drug pricing reform, greater transparency, increased competition, and major reforms to the Department of Veterans Affairs that are long overdue.
On immigration, Dr. Mike supports ending the incentives that encourage illegal immigration, streamlining the immigration court system, and designating the cartels as Foreign Terrorist Organizations.

Delaware faces a critical election this November. Voters have the opportunity to retire a career politician, and Republicans across the state need to be firing on all cylinders to stop Democrats from securing a supermajority in the state legislature. With Dr. Mike Katz at the top of the ticket, Delaware has the opportunity to change course.
Vote for Dr. Mike Katz!

endorsements.summary: We had a great conversation with Michael and he has shown that he is the most America First candidate in the FL-22 race.
paragraphs: Michael was born in this newly drawn district, and was raised in said district, he then worked on the other side of the district, being one of the only candidates who is in touch with both sides of the district.
Michael is a very strong supporter of mass deportations, and making the American immigration system for Americans. This includes ending H-1Bs and OPTs.

Standing for pro-life and pro-gun policies, Michael will ensure that DC fights for what's right. Michael is focused on bringing home ownership back to reality rather than a dream, ensuring that our Constitution is followed, and that America remains America.
Vote for Michael Thompson!
America First Insight is proud to be endorsing Paul Gosar for another term. Paul is a true fighter, and has been fighting to reduce immigration since day one.
Always there for America on the House's floor. We look forward to his continued service!

Florida's 19th Congressional District has been open for quite some time and, as one of the oldest open seats in the country, has attracted significant national attention. Out of the large field of candidates, we believe John Strand is the strongest America First candidate in the race.

Like many Americans, John first became politically active during the COVID-19 pandemic. That experience has ultimately led him to run for Congress on a platform centered around reclaiming the Republic.

A core of John's agenda is a commitment to restoring America's sovereignty. He supports deporting millions of illegal immigrants, implementing a multi-year moratorium on immigration, opposing the H-1B and OPT programs, and ensuring that those who come to America embrace and assimilate into the nation's culture rather than replacing it.

Beyond immigration, John supports lowering taxes, defending the Second Amendment, protecting the right to life, and bringing accountability back to Washington. One proposal that particularly stands out is his support for defunding the District of Columbia District Court, which he argues has become an institution dedicated to protecting the Washington establishment instead of delivering equal justice under the law.
John Strand has earned the endorsement of Turning Point Action, and today he also earns the full endorsement of America First Insight.
We are confident John will be an outstanding Congressman and a principled America First voice for Florida's 19th District.
Vote John Strand for Congress!

We had the opportunity to speak with Will, and he understands what lies ahead. Wisconsin has been one of the nation's premier battleground states for over a decade, making it essential that the Republican ticket is as strong as possible. Will has the opportunity to be an outstanding addition to that ticket.

Will brings years of experience in Wisconsin's executive branch, having served under multiple governors. That experience gives him the knowledge needed to help Tom Tiffany build an effective administration from day one.

Will also stands for commonsense America First policies. He believes government-funded university jobs should prioritize hiring Americans instead of giving foreign workers the first opportunity through visa programs.

Throughout his career, Will has delivered real results. He led Wisconsin's welfare-to-work initiatives and worked alongside the Trump administration to establish Economic Opportunity Zones, demonstrating his commitment to creating opportunities for Wisconsin families while being a responsible steward of taxpayer dollars.

Will also played a key role in helping Wisconsin enact voter photo ID requirements and has continued working to strengthen the Wisconsin Republican Party. Committed to freedom, opportunity, and prosperity, Will Martin is ready to serve as Wisconsin's next Lieutenant Governor.
Vote for Will Martin!

We had the opportunity to speak with Kevin Steele, whose family has called Tampa home for four generations. With the newly Republican-leaning FL-14, Kevin is making the jump from the Florida State House to a campaign for Congress.

Like many Americans, Kevin became deeply involved in politics during the COVID-19 pandemic. Since then, he has fought in the Florida Legislature to advance policies focused on affordability, enforcement, and protecting Florida families.

Kevin has taken a strong enforcement-first approach on immigration, recognizing that fixing America's immigration system goes beyond securing the border. He believes Americans should not be placed second in their own job market and has been outspoken against the abuse of programs like H-1B visas and OPT that can disadvantage American workers.

During his time in the Florida Legislature, Kevin supported policies that expanded cooperation between Florida and ICE, ended taxpayer-funded in-state tuition benefits for illegal immigrants, and strengthened Florida's E-Verify requirements.

Kevin also shared an innovative idea to address one of Florida's biggest challenges: rising insurance costs. He supports creating a Homes Savings Account, modeled after the Health Savings Account, which would allow Americans to save and spend money tax-free for home-related expenses. This could help reduce insurance costs, increase affordability, and make homeownership more attainable for families across the country.
Kevin's business mindset, focus on lowering insurance costs, and commitment to immigration enforcement make him an excellent candidate to represent Florida's 14th Congressional District.
Vote for Kevin Steele for Congress!
We are proud to announce our endorsement for Sydney Gruters. Sydney has the TPUSA and Trump endorsement. She will support the Trump Agenda, and back increases to ICE's budget.
She already has a strong understanding of Congress, previously working for great Congressman Greg Steube. She will be a great addition to the GOP House!
Vote for Sydney!
Ben is a ninth-generation Floridian, a longtime dairy farmer, and a member of the South Florida Water Management District.

Ben currently leads the Republican primary field in fundraising from individual donations and has earned the backing of much of Okeechobee and Highlands counties, along with endorsements from Kat Cammack and Greg Steube. Those endorsements reflect the strong grassroots support he has built throughout the district.

Throughout his career in government and agriculture, Ben has worked to protect and restore rural Florida. Combined with his firsthand experience as a dairy farmer, he understands the challenges facing America's agricultural communities and will fight to cut unnecessary red tape, strengthen small businesses, and ensure family farms can thrive.
Ben is a strong supporter of the Second Amendment, is unapologetically pro-life, and is committed to keeping the southern border secure.
Ben will be a valuable addition to the Republican Conference, helping lead reforms that make American agriculture more profitable, more secure, and more America First.
Vote for Ben!

Florida has been the leading conservative state for quite some time under Ron DeSantis. Ron oversaw the massive shift in this state from a battleground to a safe GOP state, and now the time to pick his successor is here, and Byron Donalds is the choice.

Byron Donalds has been a fantastic Congressman. He has an A+ from us, an A+ from NumbersUSA, and the highest score among Florida's congressional delegation from TPUSA. He has consistently shown that he is there for America First.

Byron Donalds has shown that he doesn't buckle under political pressure, standing up against the Parkland gun control laws during his freshman year in the Florida Legislature. Byron Donalds has also pledged his support for repealing Florida's Red Flag law, repealing the state's bump stock ban, and expanding our Constitutional Carry law into a true Constitutional Carry system.
Byron opposed Amendment 3 in 2024 and continues to oppose future expansion of legalized weed in the State of Florida.
Byron has great policies he wants to implement to help make Florida more affordable. His Insurer Scorecard would be a fantastic reform, and we hope the state legislature is willing to get it done.

Byron Donalds has been fantastic on immigration while serving in Congress, and he will continue ensuring that Florida becomes the most hostile state for illegal immigrants to inhabit. Donalds wants to mandate 287(g) agreements and expand bans on public spending for illegal immigrants.
Donalds backs school choice, ensuring that data centers pay their fair share, the pro-life movement, and reforming Florida healthcare to make it more free market.
Donalds has already served in Tallahassee, and with the backing of President Trump, the state legislature should be very cooperative when it comes to keeping Florida great.
Vote for Byron Donalds!

We had the opportunity to speak with Ryan and believe he is the best bet for FL-07, this primary season. Ryan has been a News Anchor for 14 years in the local area, and has been involved in politics for years, reporting on it.

Ryan is pro-ending the abuse from H-1Bs and OPT, putting the American workers first! Ryan has also seen questionable immigration first hand. As he watched people on visas being bussed into a local town during the Biden admin, and reported on this.
Ryan will stand up for the Save America Act, if elected to the house, calling it one of his top priorities, other than ensuring America is affordable.
This race is about ensuring we have a Congressman who isn't compromised. The current incumbent let Ilhan Omar off the hook in exchange for not being censured.
There is no question that Ryan Elijah is the America First candidate in this race! Vote for Ryan!
Bob Onder has been a fantastic representative, and we are proud to be endorsing him for another term.
Bob is a true America First Fighter, vote for Bob!
Eric has been a fighter for America First, winning a Patriot Award from us!
Vote for Eric!

For the Republican US Senate Special Primary Runoff, we are endorsing Ralph Norman!

Ralph Norman was our 1st choice for Governor, and our 2nd choice for this seat, but he has always been a fighter for America First ideas!
Vote Norman!
